## Result

- Skill: verify
- Status: success
- Artifacts changed: Verify report and matching registry/applicability/activity completion only.
- Open blockers: none.
- Next stage: return to Route; this bounded cleanup is complete. PR is optional and separately authorized.
- Validation: focused named checks passed; unchanged baseline prose errors and readability advisories disclosed below.
- Readiness: governed final closeout for the exact inspected subjects; no Git/PR readiness or hosted CI claim.

## Change and rationale

Requested outcome is workflow-final-verification, execution mode governed-final, resource profile VP1-final-readiness. The exact selected change is 2026-09-09-simplify-required-validation-and-design-retention on review/consolidate-necessary-design. This is distinct Verify after fresh independent whole-change Code Review, not a substitute review or an implementation correction. Current context established final verify in progress, the sole M1 completed, all five required reviews approved on current engineering identities, and no registered findings or blockers. I authored none of the engineering or earlier assessments.

The delivered result removes the selected 58-line validation ADR, its 35-line component diagram and three duplicate architecture subsections. Current navigation reaches Design, Test and System; FU-012 distinguishes completed common Skill adoption from remaining validation execution ownership. Design defines precise necessary-source retention, Test defines scoped proportionate proof and exact retained retirement obligations, and System composes those owners and exact source dispositions. Two legacy amendments preserve the applicable unselected operational populations. No entire specification, operational fixture or test is deleted. No new model is built; Distribution, Installation, Release and Validation Execution remain provisional candidate responsibilities with explicit current legacy authority and later owner decisions.

TG-01 and TG-FINAL-01 realize DES-SR-13/18/21 and SYS-SR-02/06/07 through complete destination ownership, justified source absence and historical separation. TG-02 realizes consumer reconciliation under DES-SR-18 and SYS-SR-04/08/09: current links resolve, exact removal boundaries hold, unrelated subsections and the historical follow-on remain unchanged, and a retired target is unavailable as a current owner. TG-03 applies TEST-SR-08/10/12/14 and SYS-SR-04 to actual dependency impact. No package or runtime rerun is inferred from a documentation suffix or a missing filename alone.

I inspected the original ADR, actual architecture diff and receiving clauses. Canonical/resource integrity, supported-target transformation and byte parity, composed release proof, deterministic record validation, semantic assessment and conditional filesystem materialization remain precise in Skill, recording owners and retained published-skill-first R1–13/R15/16/R21/R24–29. Test's retained-contract table preserves protected-failure mapping, applicability, unknown-protection investigation, detection or explicit obligation retirement and recoverability; it removes only this cleanup's redundant ledger/repetition/measurement prescriptions. SYS-DEC-04 retains meaningful rejected alternatives and the distinction between nondeterministic runtime certification and legitimate runtime defect reporting. No generic preserve-behavior promise replaces a removed rule. Historical approvals are not used as approval of replacement content. The revised models and scoped amendments now have reviewed coherent implementation and this successful Verify as their adoption basis.

## Exact basis and evidence

Current authoritative review chain: proposal-review-r2, design-review-r2 with all five package members, delivery-review-r1 with the exact plan, code-review-m1-r1 and fresh code-review-final-r1. All have approved judgments, no findings and actual nonauthor separation. Each current review's engineering subjects matches live SHA-256 identities. The final whole-change review covers the contribution from bd918a74 through completed implementation; subsequent registry/review recording changes do not alter those engineering subjects. Earlier proposal/design r1 remain stale on original subjects. The whole current registry was inspected for work, applicability, references, concerns and activity coherence.

Direct commands run during this Verify:

- `python scripts/validate-boundary-first.py --path docs/design/design/design.md --path docs/design/test/test.md --path docs/design/system/system.md --path specs/published-skill-first-repository-simplification.md --path specs/published-skill-first-repository-simplification.test.md`: passed structure and references only.
- `python scripts/validate-documentation-prose.py --mode enforce --path docs/design/design/design.md --path docs/design/test/test.md --path docs/design/system/system.md --path docs/plans/2026-09-09-necessary-design-consolidation.md --path docs/plan.md --path docs/follow-ups.md`: passed, zero errors or warnings across six paths.
- `python scripts/validate-markdown-readability.py docs/plans/2026-09-09-necessary-design-consolidation.md docs/architecture/system/architecture.md docs/follow-ups.md`: passed with 822 nonblocking advisories.
- `node scripts/validate-record-store.mjs docs/changes/2026-09-09-simplify-required-validation-and-design-retention/change.json`: passed structure and references; not itself a readiness judgment.
- `git diff --check ca440d8e^ HEAD`: passed.
- `git diff --exit-code ca440d8e^ HEAD -- skills scripts packages dist schemas templates`: passed with empty output.
- Inspected full-range diff inventory and exact M1 architecture/follow-up diff, original ADR with `git show 748ff69f:docs/adr/ADR-20260810-published-skill-first-validation-architecture.md`, and exact retired filenames using `rg -n -F` across scripts, packages, skills, specs, current models and architecture. Surviving matches are explicit source-disposition entries or historical input/follow-on references, not unresolved current operational readers.
- Inspected and executed the temporary cleanup comparison helper. Its direct assertions confirmed both source absences, exactly three removed headings, unchanged unrelated subsection bodies except allocated navigation, unchanged historical follow-on, live replacement links, 329 unchanged operational input identities and no introduced architecture prose diagnostic. Its underlying before/after prose audit reported exactly 268 errors and 115 warnings on both subjects. The helper is disposable proof execution, not a new repository validator; durable expected outcomes and observations reside in the approved plan and M1 evidence.

M1 evidence is reused only for its still-applicable bounded observations, including legacy-header comparison and candidate dependency inspection. Current engineering identities, fresh source/operational comparisons and unchanged check implementation/configuration in the same checkout support that reuse under RC-SR-15; no contrary evidence or freshness override was found. Initial authoring evidence with old System/architecture identities is historical input and is not a current universal pass. The candidate-spec audit remains a retained-versus-partial-consolidation assessment, not permission to delete those specs.

## Limitations and residual risks

Documentation, owner-policy and change-local governance are affected and assessed. Runtime/API, operational state/migration, dependency/build inputs, package generation, release metadata, security implementation and external environment are unaffected: the complete operational diff is empty, 329 inputs retain their identities, npm publishes its declared dist/metadata/README/LICENSE inputs, and adapter building consumes canonical skills, mapped resources and adapter templates rather than the removed explanatory sources. Current candidate metadata therefore has an inspected unaffected disposition. No changed archive identity needs regeneration. This establishes bounded non-impact, not a fresh package or runtime pass. Runtime write/identity/containment/recovery safeguards still apply to the record operations used here.

Full legacy prose conformance is not claimed: architecture retains 268 baseline errors and 115 warnings, and retained legacy specs retain three unchanged template-header errors. The approved plan explicitly assesses introduced prose against baseline; no new diagnostic exists and authored current prose passes. Readability advisories are disclosed above. Broad runtime/package/release execution and hosted CI were not run or claimed, consistent with the plan's affirmative TG-03 boundary; no test was deleted or demoted. An initial discovery probe for a nonexistent generate-adapters.py filename failed and was corrected by locating and inspecting the actual build-adapters.py/adapter_distribution.py owners; it supplies no validation evidence.

Historical citations may intentionally name removed originals; they cannot establish current reliance on those subjects. Necessary current rules are readable without reconstructing history. Newly discovered actual consumers, changed replacement meaning or contradictory evidence require owned correction and reassessment. Scope does not establish universal baseline correctness, finish FU-012's remaining execution work, close FU-013/014 or remaining skill adoption, or measure runtime/token savings. No publication, customer installation, push, PR preparation or external handoff is authorized or performed. Successful Verify completes only this selected source cleanup and returns control to Route.
